rows.text: A hash map uses collision resolution techniques like chaining or open addressing to handle collisions. Chaining stores multiple entries in a linked list at the same index. Open addressing finds another open slot nearby. Both ensure efficient data retrieval despite hash collisions.

rows.text: A robot found a paintbrush. It dipped it in paint and made a mark. It tried again. Soon, it painted beautiful pictures. The robot learned to paint. It was happy. It never got tired. It kept painting. It was a great artist. It painted all day. It was a wonderful robot.

rows.text: TCP is connection oriented and guarantees delivery while UDP is connectionless and does not guarantee delivery. TCP is slower but more reliable while UDP is faster but less reliable.

rows.text: Romeo and Juliet is a tragic love story about two young lovers from feuding families in Verona. Their secret marriage and eventual deaths unite their families, ending the long-standing feud.

rows.text: Supervised learning uses labeled data to train models, while unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data. Supervised learning predicts outcomes, and unsupervised learning groups or clusters data.
